text: Niece, 7. Temp 38.5. Her eczema's flared up, the dry itchy patches on her arms and behind her knees. There's also a reddish rash on her tummy but I did the glass test and it goes pale when pressed. A few raised red spots on her ankles too, those are mosquito bites, she was out in the garden all day yesterday. Does she need to be seen tonight or not?
